# Gruesome Scourger (M20). "When this creature enters, it deals damage to target opponent or
# planeswalker equal to the number of creatures you control."
# Event: Skeleton Archer's ETB. Amount: Kabira Takedown's census QCount (B9-census-damage-kabira).
# Target: Chandra's Magmutt's player-or-planeswalker selector with the player side narrowed to
# opponents, Zone(PLAYER, OPPONENT) (templates_b2b._target_opponent); same as Sorcerer of the Fang.
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {
        'amount': QCount(
            selector=Selector(
                count=QUnbounded(),
                mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                filter=FAnd(
                    children=(
                        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                    ),
                ),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
        ),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FOr(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Planeswalker'),
                    FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_PERMANENT)),
                ),
            ),
            zones=(
                Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
                Zone(kind=ZoneKind.PLAYER, controller=ControllerRef.OPPONENT),
            ),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [etb, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, it deals damage to target opponent or planeswalker equal to the number of creatures you control.

mapping.notes: target opponent or planeswalker as Sorcerer of the Fang; amount = Kabira Takedown census.
